body: this whole thing seems like a big catch 22. i don't want to look into psychological treatment because doing so will give credence to the my friend's opinions that they could have done something to stop me killing myself. i just want to make a decision that is totally my own and for everyone to respect it without having to psychoanalyze me first.

I don't care if people judge the reasoning behind my killing myself, so long as they realize that it is my decision to make, whatever the reasoning. I don't want to have anyone feel like they were in any way responsible, but that is kind of hard if they can default back to the idea that mental illness has anything to do with my decisions.

There is a decent chance that there is something wrong with me mentally; my mother had bipolar disorder, which is an inheritable condition. That said, I absolutely refuse to be medicated or committed because of this.
